title: पाठ-योजना — वर्णपरिचयः (Class 6 CBSE Sanskrit)
subject: Sanskrit
objectives: Explain the difference between स्वर (vowel) and व्यञ्जन (consonant).
Recite the 13 स्वराः and identify ह्रस्व / दीर्घ.
Recite the 33 व्यञ्जनानि and identify the five वर्गाः.
Identify the five उच्चारण-स्थानानि (places of articulation).
Form basic मात्रा-संयोगाः (consonant + vowel) like क का कि की कु कू.
Recognise common संयुक्ताक्षराणि — क्ष, त्र, ज्ञ.
Identify the शिरोरेखा and the देवनागरी-संख्या-वर्णाः.
prerequisites: Familiarity with Hindi alphabet (helpful, since both share Devanagari).
Ability to read and write Devanagari letters from Class 5.
materials: Cards with single वर्णाः for sorting games
Mirror (one per pair) for observing mouth-shape during उच्चारण

activities.description: Hook with a question: 'अ आ इ ई' इति कथम् उच्चार्यन्ते? Take responses; explain that each varṇa has a specific place in the mouth.
Hand mirrors to pairs. Students pronounce अ इ उ क च ट त प and observe where each sound is produced. Discuss in pairs.
teacher_actions: Walk around; ask 'where do you feel it?'
student_actions: Note the place of each sound.

activities.description: Cover four blocks: (i) स्वराः with hrasva/dīrgha; (ii) व्यञ्जनानि with five वर्गाः; (iii) उच्चारण-स्थानानि — कण्ठ-तालु-मूर्ध-दन्त-ओष्ठ; (iv) मात्राः and संयुक्ताक्षराणि.
teacher_actions: Write the varṇa-mālā on the board.
Demonstrate matra placement (क का कि की …).
Show क्ष त्र ज्ञ formation step by step.

activities.description: Worksheet practice: 6 questions on classification, recitation, मात्रा-formation and संयुक्ताक्षर decomposition.
Exit ticket: 4 quick questions, one from each block.
Homework: write five short Sanskrit words and underline each स्वर and circle each व्यञ्जन.

homework: Write all 33 व्यञ्जनानि in the correct order.
Write 'क' with all 10 vowel-mātrās: क का कि की कु कू के कै को कौ.
Decompose three संयुक्ताक्षराणि into their parts: क्ष = ?, त्र = ?, ज्ञ = ?.
assessment_ideas: Use the 4-item exit ticket as formative.
Mark the LONG_ANSWER on पञ्च-वर्ग-व्यवस्था using the rubric in the answer key.
references: NCERT Class 6 Sanskrit — Deepakam (दीपकम्), Chapter 1: वर्णपरिचयः.
